rationale: Approve one durable documentation package and one two-task launch queue. The queue implements only the first understood vertical milestone: an atomic event-backed change API followed by dependency-gated wave dispatch with audited override. Worktrees, merge/replan, halts, healing, lineage, eval metrics, and UI remain roadmap phases until the foundation produces implementation evidence.

worker_package.objective: Create the durable change-control-plane evidence and architecture package, update project navigation, and create one schema-valid local launch queue for the event-backed change/wave foundation.
verify: $env:ORCHESTRATOR_TEST='1'; npx tsx -e "import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { parse } from 'yaml'; import { validateTaskQueue } from './server/index.ts'; const queue=parse(readFileSync('queues/change-control-foundation-v1.yaml','utf8')); const validated=validateTaskQueue(queue); if(validated.tasks.length!==2) process.exit(1); console.log('queue valid', validated.tasks.map(t=>t.key).join(','));"

$files=@('docs/architecture/change-control-plane/README.md','docs/architecture/change-control-plane/evidence-ledger.md','docs/architecture/change-control-plane/target-architecture.md','docs/architecture/change-control-plane/decisions.md','docs/architecture/change-control-plane/metrics-and-evals.md','docs/architecture/change-control-plane/implementation-roadmap.md','queues/change-control-foundation-v1.yaml'); foreach($file in $files){ if(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) -or (Get-Item -LiteralPath $file).Length -eq 0){ throw "Missing or empty: $file" } }
stop_if: A required write falls outside allowed_files.
Any architecture statement presents inference or unknown Nikolay behavior as observed fact.
The launch queue needs implementation details not fixed by the architecture decisions.
A queue task lacks exact allowedPaths, verificationCommands, dependencies, or executionGuards.
A second queue or sequential plan would depend on feedback from code that has not been implemented yet.
The queue validator or repository verification fails twice for the same unexplained cause.

evidence: server/index.ts queue validation and scheduling contracts
parallel_safety: T007 is one write Worker. The generated queue itself is sequential because both tasks own the same change-control server files.
missing_evidence: Later queue boundaries depend on the persisted event-spine implementation and are intentionally not represented as launch-ready files.
required_board_updates: Do not create a sequential plan for a single queue.
